# EvenX

> Split bills and shared expenses with friends, roommates, couples, and groups. EvenX is a mobile app for iOS and Android that tracks who owes what and settles up fast.

EvenX is built by Praxis Innovations Inc. It handles group expense splitting, trip costs, rent, and everyday shared spending. The marketing site at evenx.io includes an interactive split-expenses calculator, feature overviews, and downloadable app links.

## Tools

- [Split Expenses Calculator](https://www.evenx.io/split-expenses): Interactive tool for splitting bills by amount, percentage, or shares
- [Home](https://www.evenx.io/): Overview, features, screenshots, and app store links

## Use Cases

- [Split Bills App](https://www.evenx.io/split-bills-app): Bill splitting for groups, trips, and roommates
- [Expense Splitting App](https://www.evenx.io/expense-splitting-app): Track and split shared expenses
- [Shared Expense Tracker](https://www.evenx.io/shared-expense-tracker): Keep a running ledger of group spending
- [Rent Split Calculator](https://www.evenx.io/rent-split-calculator): Fair rent division by room size, income, or custom shares
- [Splitwise Alternative](https://www.evenx.io/splitwise-alternative): Compare EvenX to Splitwise
